SELECT internal_instances.project_id, internal_instances.principal_id 
FROM internal_instances 
WHERE internal_instances.id = ?

SELECT projects.id, projects.owner_id, projects.runtime_id, projects.name 
FROM projects 
WHERE projects.id = ? AND projects.owner_id = ?

SELECT internal_app_runs.id 
FROM internal_app_runs JOIN internal_run_bindings ON internal_run_bindings.app_run_id = internal_app_runs.id 
WHERE internal_run_bindings.run_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.instance_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.principal_id = ?

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(internal_releases.snapshot, ?)), ?)), ?) AS namespace, internal_app_runs.id AS aid, internal_app_runs.release_id, runs.runtime_id, runs.request_key, internal_instances.source_app_id 
FROM internal_app_runs JOIN internal_run_bindings ON internal_run_bindings.app_run_id = internal_app_runs.id JOIN internal_releases ON internal_releases.id = internal_app_runs.release_id JOIN internal_instances ON internal_instances.id = internal_app_runs.instance_id JOIN runs ON runs.id = internal_run_bindings.run_id 
WHERE internal_run_bindings.run_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.instance_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.principal_id = ? AND runs.principal_id = ? AND runs.project_id = ? AND internal_releases.principal_id = ? AND internal_releases.project_id = ?
